description: Shares a folder and everything in it with a member of the organization, or changes their permission, as Share in the app does. A member new to the folder gets an email. Needs manage on the folder, or owning it.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

permission.description: What the member can do with the folder and everything in it. `view` lets them open its reports, `edit` also lets them change them, and `manage` also lets them rename, move and share the folder and add folders to it. If the folder is already shared with the member, this replaces their permission and they aren't notified again. Rollstack also shares the files of its reports that update a Google Drive or OneDrive file with them, as the app does.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The folder to act on, by its `id` from `listFolders` or `createFolder`.

userId.description: The member to share the folder with, or to unshare it from: their `id` from `listMembers`, which only owners and admins can call, or their `userId` in `access` from `getFolder`. Only active members of the organization. Anyone the folder is shared with can unshare it from themselves.

name: shareFolder
title: Share folder
